findings.current: 此图片已无法发送。请重试或将其移除。
findings.proposed: 此图片当前无法发送。请重试或将其移除。
findings.note: English deliberately says 'no longer ready to send', a state that Retry can repair; '已无法发送' (can no longer be sent) is absolute, so the next sentence's 请重试 reads as pointless — the same defect the ru round-1 auditor raised for ru. '当前无法发送' keeps the state repairable. expired_staged (no Retry) can keep '已无法发送', since that image really cannot be sent again.
